classification_definition.EXACT: The evidence payload inserted into the historical generator prompt is archived verbatim in the July run's final post-trim context fields, and source routing at the run commit selects those fields.
classification_definition.Important: EXACT refers to evidence payload, not byte-identical full system/user prompt.
classification_definition.PARTIAL: Evidence exists but required final context component or source routing cannot be verified.
classification_definition.VERIFIED_RECONSTRUCTION: Not assigned; no non-archived evidence was synthesized.

historical_scores: Retained in eligibility registry for audit, not reused in corrected evaluation absent rubric/input equivalence proof.
previous_zero_eligible_audit_diagnosis: The old builder already pointed at the July run, so this was not a CUDA-vs-July source-run error. It required exact archived full prompts or reconstruction of every prompt field and treated missing serialized prompt bytes as incomplete; the July archive preserves final evidence payloads and the exact historical branch/template routing, enough to verify generator-visible evidence without claiming byte-identical prompts.
recommendation: Proceed with the 100-pair answerability/category-stratified evaluation only after reviewer approval; both judges receive each baseline's own archived generator-visible evidence on exactly the same IDs.

citation_representation.B3/code_B4: Evidence contains explicit <|source_id|>N and Block N markers; citation references can be checked against these visible IDs.
citation_representation.B5/code_B6: Enrichment evidence contains source labels such as [Chunk], PubMed identifiers, and pages, but no numbered Block N mapping. A generated [Block N] reference is unresolved from the generator-visible payload and must be recorded as an unresolvable target, not silently mapped by retrieved_chunks order.

limitations: The original fully serialized prompt bytes are not archived.
The archived evidence strings and historical routing branch are verified; exact tokenizer-rendered prompt reconstruction is not claimed.
The B6 enrichment block is an archived output of graph expansion and is not regenerated here.

verified_routes.B3/B4: ask_no_expander inserts archived post-trim trimmed_text and trimmed_graph; config disables graph expansion.
verified_routes.B5/B6: ask_expander inserts archived enrichment_block when nonempty; block is the exact final expansion serialization, not the intermediate retrieved chunks or graph trace.
